name: Omaezaki (Japan, town)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Omaezaki town emblem in orange: a ring with a winged top divided by a vertical bar, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Omaezaki in Shizuoka Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-04-01.

features.role: Omaezaki town emblem — a ring with a winged top divided by a vertical bar, like a stylised character
